data.name: KuKu's Cinema
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to KuKu's Cinema, an immersive virtual theater where you can enjoy your own videos alone or watch together with friends.

Step into a fully designed cinema, choose your favorite seat, and experience movies on a giant screen. Whether you're relaxing by yourself or hosting a movie night, KuKu's Cinema creates a comfortable virtual space for entertainment.

Features

  • Explore a virtual cinema environment.

  • Play and watch your own local video files on the theater screen.

  • Sit in cinema seats for a more immersive movie-watching experience.

  • Create multiplayer viewing sessions and invite friends to watch together.

  • Automatic playback synchronization keeps everyone's video perfectly in sync during shared viewing.

  • Move freely around the theater while videos continue playing.

  • Enjoy your own private virtual cinema for relaxing and social entertainment.

KuKu's Cinema combines immersive environments with synchronized multiplayer video playback, making it easy to enjoy movies, videos, and shared viewing experiences with friends inside a virtual cinema.

  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 430 / ATI Radeon HD 2600XT
